versions.changelog:
Initial release of open-docker-hub skill:

- Opens Docker Hub in the Brave browser.
- Focuses existing Brave browser and reuses relevant tabs when possible.
- Navigates directly to https://hub.docker.com/ and waits for the page to load.
- Ensures no form submissions or account changes are made.
- Handles authentication by stopping at the login page if needed and notifying the user.
